footer.note: Everything runs from this panel — no terminal needed. Watch streams straight to mpv online (via the optional goanime-stream helper, falling back to a temporary cache that is deleted after playback) so nothing is saved. Download / Download all save episodes to the downloads folder and keep running in the background.
